title: Orsen and the Will
author: Ulyana Dravenmoor
blurb: Gideon Amberdale, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, has spent five years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
